WPSS No. 1254 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via Video Conferencing)
Ms. Pooja Tiwari, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Addl. C.S.C with Mr. 
N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel for the State.
The challenge in the writ petition as given by 
the petitioner to the impugned order dated 
30.09.2020 passed by the District Education Officer 
(Elementary Education) District Udham Singh 
Nagar by virtue of which the option given by the 
petitioner was held to be irrevocable and 
consequent revocability of his option was declined.
The issue requires to be considered only after 
the exchange of the pleadings by the respondents. 
Respondents are represented through Mrs. Anjali 
Bhargava, Addl. CSC who has accepted notice on 
behalf of respondent nos. 1 to 3. She may file her 
counter affidavit within a period four weeks from 
today.
List this petition thereafter.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 20.10.2020
Parul

56 WPSS No.1254 of 2020
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Ms. Devika Tiwari, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Narayan Dutt, Standing Counsel 
for the State.
It is the claim of the petitioner that he 
is working as an Assistant Teacher in 
Senior Basic School. He wanted to be 
posted as Headmaster of the Basic School, 
but his representation, which was 
submitted pursuant to the order passed in 
the earlier writ petition, has been rejected 
on the ground that it would amount to 
change of cadre, which is not permissible.
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that, in fact, the respondent￾authority have done it in the past. She has 
referred to Annexure No.10 of the writ 
petition as well as the order passed by this 
Court on 26.03.2010, passed in WPSS 
No.914 of 2006, to argue that pursuant to 
this order, a representation was decided by 
the respondent-authority and the cadre of 
the petitioner in that case was changed 
accordingly.
To it, learned State Counsel seeks 
time to get instructions on this aspect.
Let respondent-authority file a short 
affidavit, particularly, with regard to 
Annexure No.10 and the action that has 
been taken pursuant to the order dated 
26.03.2010, passed in WPSS No.914 of 
2006, of which copy is Annexure No.12 to 
the writ petition. Let it be filed within three weeks.
List this matter on 18.06.2026, for 
final hearing. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
21.05.2026
RV
